violations.description: Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Nonfood contact surface * was not cleaned adequately. . Microwave requires cleaning.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…)* were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. - Floors and walls throughout dirty.

Control of insects, rodents, and other pests. — --Insects, rodents, or other pests were not controlled in a manner specified in the food service code to minimize their presence within the facility. - Excessive flies in the kitchen and food prep area.

Clean-in-place (CIP) equipment - Design and construction. — --Food contact surface of clean in place equipment * was not cleaned properly. Cutting board on the prep table behind the serving counter had blue liquid under it.
Manual cleaning and sanitizing requirements. — --Sani-bucket was old and did not have sanitizer solution in it. when tested registered 0ppm. Other buckets were 200ppm.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…)* were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. - Floor throughout should be swept more frequently.
Storage and handling of maintenance items. — --Wet-use maintenance items, such as mops, were not placed in a position that allows proper air-drying. - Mop not hung to drip and dry when not in use.
Cleaning frequency, maintained clean (1 pt deducted)
